title: Pozy M NDE 752
content: It happened when I was bathing in a pond. My younger sister started to drown and I made a dash towards the water to save her life. I managed to save her but got into a whirlpool myself. I was trying to bounce and take a breath but after a few moments, I got too deep and realized I had no more strength to fight with the water. When my feet touched the bottom, I knew I was not going to survive. The moment I thought about it I felt very warm and peaceful. I no longer felt anything else. I just felt good. All of a sudden, I saw a film showing all my life. All negative and bad aspects of my life, I could now feel myself deep in my soul. I was very ashamed of what I saw. Then I saw a tunnel with a bright light at the end of it. The light was loving and very bright, so bright that my eyes hurt. Some figures of people came out of that light. I heard a voice asking me if I was sure I'd done everything in my life. I still felt this terrible shame and answered, 'I don't think so.' The voice replied, 'Then go back and finish your work!' I didn't even have time to think about what the voice said because I suddenly felt a piercing and shooting pain. I took my first breath and it was horrible! The pressure burst a few of my air sacs, which lead to an extensive bleeding. The results of this can still be seen on my body.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Clinical death I was drowning!
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was aware of everything that was going on.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: I heard the voice coming from the light.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes A narrow tunnel with a bright light at the end.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Only the voice in the light.
elements.The experience included: Light | Life review | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Beautiful, very bright, I could see figures of people.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt good, did not feel any pain, I felt loved and needed.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I found out that you have to take the responsibility for your bad actions later. What's more, I found out I'd not done anything on Earth I could pride myself on 'there' in all my life! Now I try to help people more.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I have prophetic dreams and see events that are to happen. I was able to prevent some of them.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes My values and beliefs have changed. Money matters are less important, are in the background.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I know I have a huge energetic potential. I was examined by a ......... I have helped many people reduce their suffering and (as I mentioned before) have prophetic dreams. I feel 'higher vibes' and know which organ in someone's body is ill. I know people's feelings.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part was not feeling the pain and being immersed in this wonderful loving light. The worst was the question whether I did everything in my life. I was really ashamed!!!
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Their reactions were different. From critical to respectful.
